reference_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.product_id) AS n_products
FROM price_history a
JOIN price_history b
  ON b.product_id = a.product_id
 AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from
 AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_from <= a.valid_to)
alternatives:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.product_id) AS n_products
FROM price_history a
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM price_history b
  WHERE b.product_id = a.product_id
    AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from
    AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_from <= a.valid_to)
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.product_id) AS n_products FROM price_history a JOIN price_history b ON b.product_id = a.product_id AND a.valid_from < b.valid_from AND b.valid_from <= COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')

other_way.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.product_id) AS n_products
FROM price_history a
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM price_history b
  WHERE b.product_id = a.product_id
    AND b.valid_from > a.valid_from
    AND (a.valid_to IS NULL OR b.valid_from <= a.valid_to)
)
other_way.tradeoff: EXISTS asks whether a later window starts too early without pairing rows, but the self-join lets you show both windows.

solver.query:
WITH ov AS (
  SELECT a.product_id, a.valid_from AS a_from, a.valid_to AS a_to, a.list_price_eur AS a_price,
         b.valid_from AS b_from, b.valid_to AS b_to, b.list_price_eur AS b_price
  FROM price_history a
  JOIN price_history b ON a.product_id = b.product_id AND a.valid_from < b.valid_from
  WHERE b.valid_from <= COALESCE(a.valid_to, DATE '9999-12-31')
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT product_id) AS n_products FROM ov
